How to define a customer toolbar?
We can easily define a customized toolbar for the Automation Center.
It can be used to standardize the Automation Center toolbar between different users/computers.
• Create a new user variable

-- 1 of 2 --

2
• Define the variable name (HC_ADDITIONAL_HCCONFIG)
• Define the variable value (insert here the folder where the toolbar config will be dumped)
The possibility to define a customer toolbar will appear in the Automation Center configuration.
